notes: A big one: Duel Field gets a turn timer that speeds up (with a clear ⚡2x/4x marker) if nobody's taken a real action in a while - right-click it to turn that off. Deck Doctor gives one combined report (legality, draw simulation, suggestions) instead of three separate screens. Pack Odds Simulator previews a pack's real pull odds before it goes live. Version History can compare two saved versions against each other, not just a version vs. the current deck. Export Proxy Sheet PDF prints a 3x3 card grid. Combo Board can export a step-by-step GIF walkthrough. Replay Theatre has a playback speed control. Cross-machine account sync via a shared folder (Drive/Dropbox/Mega). Pack Shop shows completion (owned/total pullable) on every pack tile, plus a searchable Full Pull Log across every pack. Bulk Text Fix finds/replaces across every card's text or name in one pass. Save/Load Position snapshots and restores a board state for solo testing or puzzles. Card Edit History tracks a diff of what changed on a card, and when. A 'What's New' popup now shows what changed after you update. Lobby remembers your last Host/Join setup.
